result.reason: The redline establishes a mutual greater-of cap, but it uses the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim as the lookback trigger. More importantly, the supplied operative language never defines Excluded Claims, so none of the required carve-outs can be credited based on the non-operative margin comment. It also omits the mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion and the treatment of Customer payment obligations. The fallback is not complete because the cap can exceed twelve months' Fees and none of its required carve-outs is operatively identified.
